t: Titan pressure washer patio brush designed for efficient surface cleaning. Features high-density spray pattern, a quick connect system and tough bristles to lift stubborn dirt and debris. An adjustable pressure setting enables usage on a variety of surfaces. Designed to stay planted to the patio surface when being manoeuvred. Compatible with T1 to T5 pressure washers.
b: Suitable for up to 2610psi Pressure Washers
